newsitem.title: LATVIA: BOURSE OFFICIALY TO LAUNCH NEW INDEX.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE OFFICIALY TO LAUNCH NEW INDEX.

text.p: The stock exchange said on Tuesday that it will tomorrow launch its new bourse index, the launch of which was originally scheduled for the start of April.

Bourse president Uldis Cerps said that the index would be as originally planned, consisting of nine companies and calculated according to a weighting given to each share in the index, based on the company's market capitalisation.
He said there would be a small presentation of the new index on June 18.
"it is totally proportional to the market capitalisation," Cerps told Reuters, describing how the index worked.
Cerps said the index would be published on the stock exchange's daily trading bulletin and on its internet page.
The market is currently tracked by a variety of indices, including those of Rietumu and Saules Bank.
